---
title: "How to add media and interactive elements"
order: 1
---

This module demonstrates how to add links, images, videos, and exercises to your training content. Each topic presents the Markdown and Quarto syntax alongside the rendered result, so you can see how different elements appear to participants.

Explore the examples, copy the snippets you need, and adapt them for your own training pages.

<br>

## In this module

- [**Topic 1 – Links:**](/content/module-3/links.qmd) Link to websites, documents, and other resources to guide participants to further information.
- [**Topic 2 – Images, presentations and videos:**](/content/module-3/images-presentations-videos.qmd) Add visual media and embed presentations or videos directly in a page.
